question: Which of the following diseases are caused by fungi?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ringworm__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ringworm** is a **contagious fungal infection**.
 
• **It is** caused by common** mold-like parasites** that **live on the cells in the outer layer of your skin.**
 
• **It can be spread **in the following ways: **Human to human.**
 
• **Ringworm often spreads by direct**, **skin-to-skin contact with an infected person.**
 
• **It is **caused by a** type of fungus** that eats** keratin. **
 
• **These are called dermatophytes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A heart attack occurs** when one or **more of your coronary arteries becomes blocked.**
 
• **Gallstone**s may form if** bile contains** **too much cholesterol**, too much bilirubin, or not enough bile salts.
 
• **Tonsillitis** is most often caused by** common viruses**, but **bacterial infections also can be the cause.**
 
• **Some common viral diseases in humans** - HIV/AIDS, Ebola, and COVID-19, etc.
